name: gr1-tabletop-cuttingboard-pan-post-oracle-noise01-v1
question: After restoring exact official evaluation semantics, does K=4, noise=0.1 remain within 10 percentage points of native ODE on the unchanged SFT policy?

trigger.invalidation_reason: The prior panel predates the fix that defers success termination to the end of each official eight-action chunk. Its result is supporting evidence, not training admission for the corrected runtime.

paired_design.pairing: Every ODE/SDE pair reuses the scenario, environment seed, policy seed, and initial Gaussian latent. Only the additional Flow-SDE transition differs.
paired_design.primary_interval: 10,000-sample paired cluster bootstrap over 64 reset seeds

equivalence_gate.pass: Point estimate and reset-clustered 95% interval are wholly within [-0.10, 0.10].
equivalence_gate.reject: The clustered interval excludes the equivalence region on either side, or the absolute point estimate is at least 0.20.
equivalence_gate.inconclusive: Any result that is neither pass nor reject.

decision_rule.on_pass: Admit exactly one one-task 20-update GRPO development run from the unchanged SFT base with K=4 and noise=0.1. Do not change optimization settings in the same run.
decision_rule.on_reject: Do not optimize. Stop and review the sampler and chunk-boundary interaction.
decision_rule.on_inconclusive: Do not automatically spend more GPU. Stop and review the equivalence margin and power design.
